section.11: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

11.name_native: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If any one of you says: 'Amin' and the angels in Heaven say Amin, and the one coincides with the other, his previous sins will be forgiven
